entities.name: Fazil Najafov

entities.summary: Fazil Imamverdi oghlu Najafov was an Azerbaijani sculptor and painter. He was a People's Artist of Azerbaijan (2002) and one of the founders of the avant-garde style in Azerbaijani sculpture.
